comment: Bell's gate world as the advisor corrected the instrument (2026-09-30, #1563 comment 5918198102: the 48-row board and the near field kept, the gaps two wavelengths wide with a bar between them, the screen at L = 40, the screens in regions of four rows), every number of the world read by build_world.py, which writes the world file bell_<angle>.json and its mode file (tools/pixel_mode.py, the message lay, with --modes). The flat board `length` x `height` x 1 (z folded) on the light-only universe file examples/events/light.json (rule.json with the holders of the content at the level weight 1,000,000, so light's own well stays under one level); the source's two lobes per side at the column `source` +/- `offset`, each a packet of the light family at the wave `wave` (lambda = 8) over the rows of its gap (`lobes`) with the raised-cosine edges `edge_along` and `edge_across`, at the amplitude `amplitude`; the pair's angle the relative phase of the upper lobe, (`angle` + 1/2) / `angles` of the turn on the right side and its mirror on the left; the two walls the inner faces at `source` +/- `wall` with the gaps `gaps` (16 rows each, the bar 22 to 25, d = 20); the screens at `source` +/- `screen` (L = 40 beyond the walls), each `slab` columns deep, the board's last columns backed by the receding face `receding`, declared in regions of `rows_per_region` rows from the side's first boundary (`tiling`); `ticks` intervals. The world is the engine's gate (tools/back_in_time.py), not an experiment; its blind expectation is written in the meeting round (the four small worlds, S = 478/169 exactly, the marginal one half).
